name: amend-plan accepts one in-scope hot slice on an approved plan

source.assertion:
assert_equals "a hot slice increments the operational plan revision" \
  1 "$(oso-state --session "$SESSION" get plan_revision)"

assert_equals "a hot slice reopens the overall verification flag" \
  false "$(oso-state --session "$SESSION" get verify_green)"

assert_equals "a hot slice never mutates the immutable approved snapshot" \
  "$approved_snapshot_before_amendment" "$(cat "$first_approved_file")"

state_before..local/state/oso-code/{repo}.state:
mode=plan
active_slice=none
verify_green=true
plan_approval=approved
plan_approval_digest=d3f0dbd7d1c0f9e0e2ed69b9b3b30a3c1f5e6fbef5db1cf4c7fdc23c4a8e0dcb
plan_approval_session=test-session
plan_snapshot_file={home}/.local/state/oso-code/plans/{repo}/approved-d3f0dbd7d1c0f9e0e2ed69b9b3b30a3c1f5e6fbef5db1cf4c7fdc23c4a8e0dcb.md
plan_current_file={home}/.local/state/oso-code/plans/{repo}/current.md
plan_revision=0
session=test-session
